notes.title: Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d01d3830acba925c4fa0421e68d0607391a1cb18.jpg

Heya,

The day has come: SuchArt is now fully and officially out. Thank you so much for supporting us all the way through the Early Access – the game wouldn’t reach its current state without your feedback, as well as there would be no community without you actively participating in the life of the SuchArt discord server and painting your masterpieces. So yeah, your contribution cannot be overestimated, and we truly appreciate it.

[previewyoutube=0F_GxnR9I28;full][/previewyoutube]

Since today is a big day indeed, you can grab SuchArt with a 20% launch discount. Moreover, you can get an additional 15% off if you purchase it as a part of our bundle with House Flipper – quite a bargain, isn’t it?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Don’t forget that we’re also running a contest in which you can win SuchArt Steam key and help us spread the word about the game at the same time – make sure to check it out!

But let’s move to the most interesting part – the new stuff we promised to tell you about (spoiler: no worries, your saves should remain safe and sound!).

Hangar

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/99a832af302d3ab2303eb59c9c1179a82fdd6b6c.png

The hangar is a new spacious area distinct from your studio. A new space with its own game mechanics, items, characters and commissions. It brings larger and more complex items to paint in game, and aims to bring more variety to the mid and late game.

=> It is unlocked shortly after reaching the 4th level of fame. You will get an email from a new character. If you load a save past this level of fame, you should quickly receive the email as well. It is also always available in Creative mode.

Gallery rework

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/7b35cd967d34391eccbe2e53bca214d65dfae188.png

The gallery has been reworked and expanded. It is now much bigger, and has a new area with its distinct atmosphere and display mechanics.

The Virtualizer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/0502df36cd70226460844b7fa6e2052c65232e8f.png

The virtualizer is a new tool which you can use to get a copy, in your gallery, of furniture and other decorative items that you possess in your studio. For a small fee.

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

The Omni Shield

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/879b696d7de9ece040384454903501437f3865a7.png

The Omni Shield is a new tool. Its advanced technology allows you to protect any surface of your choice from being painted. Blow up those spray cans safely!

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

Other changes and additions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d489194f5840b04c3b3e8a7e960f4f93a36448a6.png

- The studio has been reworked to offer more space in the main area
- The corridor and elevator can now be accessed again after the introduction
- Unique items from the Story mode are now also available in the Creative mode, from the shop
- Shop: shorter and universal delivery times, replaced delivery timer with a progress bar
- Added step ladders in the shop
- Added 5 new pieces of furniture in the shop
- Lowered the price of many furniture items
- Re-organized the shop categories
- Updated lacquer sprays and added multiple cap variants (now similar to the regular spray cans)
- Faster running speed
- Various optimizations
- Cleaner canvases models

Fixes

- Tablet support has been improved and should work properly with more devices / setups
- Fixed partially broken Journal UI for some screen resolutions
- Fixed some game credit entries
- Fixed some obscure PetBot issues
- Range of minor / other fixes

Saves compatibility

Your old saves should be compatible with the update, with a few quirks:
- Some items may be relocated during the update
- A few walls and floors in the studio (main room, downstairs) have been remodelled for the studio enlargement. Anything you have painted there (walls, floor, ceiling, window, etc) will likely be altered with the update.


If you come across any issues or bugs, please report them either on our Discord server or in the comment below this post, cheers.

We hope you have a fantastic artistic journey – bon voyage!

notes.title: When is SuchArt coming out?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/c87ae3f8a5f9b3b518b200ebe35d630866031a99.jpg

Hey everyone!

We know that many of you have been waiting for SuchArt to be released for quite a while now — we get lots of questions about the release date/time every day, we see all of them, yet we can’t give a proper answer, which can possibly be quite disturbing for you. What we definitely don’t want is you being disturbed, that’s why we believe it’s the right time to share our release plans and explain why we’re not giving any specific dates just yet.

First of all, we’d like to reassure you a bit: the game itself is stable — all the core features are ready, and we’re now mainly adding new languages and fixing some minor bugs. Thanks to our awesome Discord community we managed to select people who’ve been helping us with the game testing over the past months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/1f10b268d1aa250c907cac3d8cf0cb889c2ad439.gif
Please be kind to your PetBot!

There’ll be a lot of stuff awaiting you upon release: a complete story campaign, a separate Creative Mode, a lovely robot assistant PetBot, and many other features related to painting and customizing your studio. Despite all this, SuchArt is likely to be released as an Early Access game. Not because it’s not finished, but because we’re planning to continue adding new features and opportunities to the game based on your future feedback, and Early Access seems to be the best option for such continuous improvements. 

In order for the game to be successful, we need to pick the best release date possible, so it’s one of the most crucial tasks for us at the moment. Release on a bad day can be critical for a small project like ours — there’s always a chance of getting lost among other releases and not getting enough attention and sales at the start (and the first days after the release are actually the most important ones). May and June happened to be extremely replete with releases and other gaming-related events: that’s why we have already postponed SuchArt release several times.

We’ve got a date in mind which we’re now aiming for (don’t worry, it’s in the foreseeable future), and we intend to announce it two weeks before the due date, when we’re 100% sure it won’t change. We really hope you understand and share our concerns and caution. 

Anyway, thank you so much for looking forward to the full version of SuchArt — it’ll be out pretty soon, just wait a tiny bit more. And you’ll love it, promise! 


Wishlist SuchArt in order not to miss it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

And, of course, have a beautiful day! <3

notes.title: Top 10 May Paintings From SuchArt Community
notes.content:
Yo,

Hope you’ve all been doing great! Time surely flies fast, and before I knew it, it was time to start compiling this top 10 May post. I could probably go all philosophical here, say that life is fleeting, art is eternal, but don’t worry, I won’t. I’ll just share these 10 awesome paintings with you — I mean, that’s what we’re all here for, right?

As usual, please don’t get upset if you haven’t made it in top 10 (you’re still doing just great, I swear!), and don’t mind the order — this time it’s actually alphabetical, +1 to fairness, you know. 

And, without any further ado, let’s get started (this time I’ve tried to come up with some captions, as promised)!


cookie the kat

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/af9989ccb33323ae973763328c40b9cf302c7496.jpg

I’ll be honest with you: I just like the cat from that meme, and I believe the cat likes it here too — who would enjoy a woman constantly shouting at them?

Dardo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/8a919f799494063ba9d8fc514e228727198857e8.jpg

I was born in the 90s, but this painting gives off such a strong 60s vibe — psychedelic culture, hippies, Woodstock… So strong, that I almost regret being born in the 90s. 

HelloRakuen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/aea8625932e2c3991d59aea9c8f41f3465ded66c.jpg

I love Miyazaki, I love Spirited Away, and I love this mural — it’s bright, neat, and simply very well painted. Great job!

Leozinho

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/0b4e691ebd26f2a8ce43b268a1319b65dc5497eb.jpg

Don’t throw any virtual rocks at me, but I haven’t watched Adventure Time. But I’ve seen a lot of Adventure Time fanart, and this work is its great example. Extra point for the pile of spray cans — I really hope it was deliberate :D

Lullu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/1d0917899e754aae0ff1ebf642444a8b374cf6fa.jpg

Can angry creatures be extremely cute at the same time? Sure, if that creature is Crabux! I mean, look at those eyes — you can see the reflection of each Earth’s ocean in them (okay, that’s obviously an exaggeration, but let me be metaphorical for once).

mellu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/d2d077c02c339480c56a98999fc8f4db565a69b3.jpg

The colors mellu used for this painting are awesome, really. Just as the horse. Neigh-neigh!

Papalsa

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/ccabbf108a411c50abb6ec0bb13be6777a46d110.jpg

This is a marvelous landscape where everything is at its own place: nice composition, awesome reflections, perfect color blending. If I existed in SuchArt world, I would definitely hang this one on my wall!

Soul's Respite

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/594b8da438be2ced26787619268a08a418e1d722.jpg

A very detailed, neat, and symbolic anime-style painting — even a default white background looks organic here.

Υojka

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/1cfc0fb7b33143bfe2465995cda4bdbc9191eb61.jpg

Omg, a sausage-cat and a bread-cat — I wouldn’t forgive myself if I hadn’t included them in this top. Well, here they are, and my conscience is clear.

ᛟ Liteforever ᛟ

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/d1127350c297790fc868f5a3ba704f03245375e3.jpg

Our last (but not least) work simply looks epic, doesn’t it? A knight, fire, a fancy sword… Let’s just suppose that a dragon didn’t get in the frame.

---------------------------

Alright, that’s it for May — hope you enjoyed all the paintings! Don’t forget to:

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/wV6Bcx8WSQ

Follow us on Twitter: @SuchArtGame

And wishlist the full game, ofc — we know that you’ve been waiting for it, so there’ll be a post regarding the release date and stuff really soon (most likely early next week), in which we’ll try to make the current situation as clear as possible. So yep, stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Have a lovely day, and we’ll see you soon!

notes.title: Top 10 April Paintings From SuchArt Community
notes.content:

Long time no see — hope you’ve all been doing great! It may now come as a bit of surprise, but we decided to renew our old traditional tops on the full game's Steam page and repost them here (I’m not even sure why we stopped doing them in the first place, but, I mean, work is hard and stuff). I guess lots of newly arrived artists don’t really know what they are, so let me re-introduce the whole thing again: at the beginning of each month, we pick 10 paintings made by all of you during the previous month that we liked the most, compile them, and bring them to you in the form of the top 10 here. Yep, pretty straightforward, but now you know!

Please note that this is not an exhaustive list of all the great works out there, so please don’t get discouraged if we didn’t include your painting in it — it absolutely doesn’t mean that you’re doing something wrong, we simply can’t include everything (even if we want to). notes.title: Turkish localization, 80,000+ players and more!
notes.content:
Hi there, 

We try not to show up empty-handed, and this time is no exception — we’re actually bringing some really good news today.

First of all, Creative Space got an update with Turkish localization, yay! A community of Turkish players has been actively evolving on our Discord, so eventually we realized that we kinda had no choice but to do it (for you know that we always listen to your needs!), and this became just a matter of time, really. And yeah, here it is now, already available in the game — you’re very welcome to try it (especially if you know Turkish).

Also, here’s a couple of other fixes/improvements:

- Minor updates to the Russian localization
- Fixed some occlusion issues (parts of the studio becoming invisible if standing in some places)
- Аdded 2560x1080 and 1920x800 screen resolutions

And, last but not least, the number of Creative Space players has grown over 80k and started looking even more impressive. Well, the more the merrier, right? Let’s celebrate this ever-increasing amount of potential genius artists by looking at some of the cool recent paintings together. Shut the lights and light a candle for a more authentic experience. notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is a small update, covering a range of fixes and minor changes.

Fixes

Fixed hanging an object on a split door could prevent the said door from closing
Fixed the emails' accepting-a-commission button not being interactable anymore after the player was getting told about already having too many ongoing commissions (ie: hard-to-phrase minor bug fix)
Fixed some bits of the delivery room not being paintable
Fixed the music ball's inventory preview not updating properly
Fixed some occlusion issues (ie parts of the studio disappearing if standing in some specific locations)
Reduced spray fumes particles effect from bright sprays, and reduced clipping from the effect
Fixed buckets would sometimes slowly but surely fly away when the game was paused
Fixed drying a wet metallic surface with the hairdryer would make the surface more reflective instead of actually drying it
Fixed fast clicking several times to sell a painting could cause the terminal to bug
Fixed buckets were kindly being delivered full of water
Fixed walking on an area freshly painted and cleaned would still produce paint steps despite having been cleaned
Applying fresh paint on top of dry paint should now mix less than before (this was especially noticeable with painting knife and with brushes low on paint)
More stable buckets (reduced jitter, especially when full of items)


Other changes

Better bobblehead and wooden easel colliders
Better blowtorch smoke effect and surface burning
Changed the rotation icon for the painting knife tool
Added a minimum required distance to be able to spill the content of a bucket (when being in hand)
Added an option to limit the FPS of the game. It seems though to cause some jitter, at least from what I have tested, I am not sure if this will be the case for everyone who tries to use it. So let's say this is still an experimental feature!


That's it! Please reach out (preferably on our discord server) if you experience any bug, and happy painting!
